annotations.annotation_text: Page 261 opens Book 2, Chapter 2 ("The Night Lessons") during the Age of Heroes phase. This passage continues the children studying the Trivium and Quadrivium, Dolph and Kev drawing geometric diagrams of ALP's body, marginal glosses and footnotes, featuring Shem (Dolph), Shaun (Kev), Issy (footnotes). The nocturnal dream-narrative layers Dublin topography, world mythology, and linguistic alchemy into polysemic prose.
sources: Campbell, Joseph and Robinson, Henry Morton. A Skeleton Key to Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/skeletonkeytofin00camp
McHugh, Roland. Annotations to Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/annotationstofin0000mchu_h5g8

JJDA: Finnegans Wake Genetic Edition. https://jjda.ie

annotations.annotation_text: Mid-page polysemic node on page 261 ("The Night Lessons"): Joyce weaves multilingual puns across 60+ languages — etymological roots from the Contemporary Literature Press lexicons (Romanian, Scandinavian, Slavic, Classical) intersect with local Dublin speech rhythms. The Age of Heroes dream-logic transforms ordinary syntax into a palimpsest of global literary and mythic references.
sources: Tindall, William York. A Reader's Guide to Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/readersguidetofi00tind
Contemporary Literature Press: Multilingual Lexicons for FW. https://editura.mttlc.ro

annotations.annotation_text: Fall/resurrection motif "broken" on page 261 ("The Night Lessons"): Tim Finnegan tumbling from his ladder, Humpty Dumpty shattering from the wall, Adam falling in Eden — all converge within the children studying the Trivium and Quadrivium, Dolph and Kev drawing geometric diagrams of ALP's body, marginal glosses and footnotes. The comic-cosmic Fall during the Age of Heroes phase demands its counterpart: resurrection through the whiskey-splash of the water of life (uisce beatha).
sources: The Ballad of Tim Finnegan's Wake. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finnegan%27s_Wake
Atherton, James S. The Books at the Wake. https://archive.org/details/booksatwake0000athe
